eia310.hole_pattern_note: 1/2 - 5/8 - 5/8 in repeating; a 1U panel normally uses the outer two holes (31.75 apart)
eia310.panel_height_1u_note: UNVERIFIED: 1U minus 1/32 in clearance; a common panel-maker convention, not confirmed against EIA-310 text

nut_trap.note: Trap AF = nut AF + 0.2 (FDM, per side ~0.1); depth = nut height + 0.3; orient flats parallel to the bed. Design rule, verify on the coupon.

n6_32.source: Coupon-proven (reported): one printed fit coupon in PLA, vertical holes, best pilot 2.6 on the 2.5-2.8 ladder. Other materials (ASA-GF, PETG) UNVERIFIED: drive a screw into a coupon first. depth_min is a design floor (about 2 x the 3.5 mm major diameter), UNVERIFIED.

unc.n6_32_nut_source: UNVERIFIED (ASME B18.2.2 from memory: 5/16 in AF, 7/64 in thick)
unc.n6_32_source: close #27 (0.1440 in), free #25 (0.1495 in): https://www.mform.com/tap-drill-chart/ ; coarse 5/32 in UNVERIFIED

install_temp_c.rule: 10-20 C above print temp (CNC Kitchen); pctg and asa by analogy to petg and abs (UNVERIFIED)
